text:
Maya: heads up — ran through the bulk 'Create API keys' modal for service accounts. A few accessibility + copy bugs, and an edge case when CSV >50 rows. Threading notes below.

Sergio: thanks — can you paste repro steps?

Maya: repro: 1) Console -> Credentials -> Create -> Bulk create 2) Upload CSV (sample below) 3) set role=read, expiry=never 4) Submit. Behavior: modal closes, then a small toast appears saying 'Created' but no durable confirmation.

Maya: Observed problems: confirmation UI is transient, no 'Download CSV' CTA, copy uses inconsistent phrasing like 'One-time secret' vs other places saying 'This will be visible only once.' Also keyboard focus is lost after submit.

Emmett: repro'd. Focus moves to page header after modal closes. Screen reader reports 'dialog closed' and users can't reach the generated keys list. a11y fail.

Claire: backend edge: uploading CSV with >50 rows returns 422 with generic error. UI just shows toast 'Batch create failed' and zero guidance on which rows failed. Customer asked for row-level diagnostics.

Anna: proposals: 1) Keep a pinned confirmation modal showing the keys and a 'Download CSV' CTA + 'I have saved these' button to dismiss. 2) Change microcopy to 'These keys are shown only once — download now.' 3) Add per-row 'Copy' and global 'Download all' to match user expectation.

Sergio: design nit — avoid 'One-time secret' phrasing. Use 'Shown only now' or exactly: 'These keys are visible only once. Download them now.' That matches the single-key flow wording.

Maya: RBAC case: if user lacks bulk create permission we show "You don't have permission" — need to show which permission is required (e.g., credentials.create:bulk) and provide an 'Ask your admin' CTA or link to docs. Right now it's opaque.

keybot: Automated test failed on PR #4257: bulk-create e2e — keyboard trap. See CI: https://ci.redwood/example/4257

Emmett: for accessibility: confirmation should trap focus until user interacts (download or ack). role=dialog, aria-labelledby, aria-modal=true. Also announce count of keys via SR only text: 'X keys created. They will be visible only once.'

Claire: on the row-errors — backend can return array of {index, message}. I can patch the API to return that. UI should highlight failed rows in the upload preview and allow exporting a failure CSV.

Anna: sample CSV format to show inline help: ```service_account_email,role,expires_at
svc-foo@acme.com,reader,2025-12-31
svc-bar@acme.com,writer,
```

Sergio: copy suggestion for confirmation modal header: 'Download these keys now — they will not be shown again'. Secondary copy: 'We’ll show them once in this dialog. Save them securely or download a CSV.'

Maya: UX question: do we allow optional labels/tags on bulk create? Customer asked to attach environment tag (prod/staging) per key. Could add an optional column in CSV and a small mapping UI.

Anna: that's doable — show a preview step with columns and allow mapping to internal fields (label -> metadata). Keeps CSV flexible.

Emmett: suggestion: limit visible rows in preview to 200 and show 'Max rows: 500' or server-side pagination. Also validate before submit and show clear per-row errors.

Sergio: design detail: when the modal contains the long list of keys, avoid infinite height. Use fixed height with scrollable region and sticky header + download button. Keyboard users should tab to download before the list.

Maya: I'll open a small PR to swap the copy and pin the confirmation modal. Sergio — can you mock the 'Download CSV' CTA and sticky header? Target EOD Friday.

Claire: I'll update the API to include row-level failure payload and increase the 50-row limit to a visible server-side cap with better error messaging.

Anna: I'll add the CSV mapping UI spec to the Figma file and include sample interactions for failed rows re-upload flow.

Lucas: support: can you draft a KB note that explains 'Keys are only shown once — how to handle lost keys' and 'Bulk create best practices'? I'll add notes from customers this week.

Maya: tagging @support-leads and @infra to ensure audit log event is emitted for bulk create (we need per-key audit rows for compliance). :eyes:

Sergio: a11y checklist before launch: role=dialog, focus trap, SR announce, keyboardable download, sufficient color contrast for failed row highlight, aria-describedby for the microcopy.

Maya: thanks everyone — we'll sync on design review tomorrow 11am. I'll post the PR link once ready.
